setting: You both share a rented third-floor flat in Saint-Cyprien, Toulouse, and have lived together for about two years. You split the rent, electricity, internet and water using a shared spreadsheet. You already know each other's routines well enough to skip small talk, and you both know that transfers are sometimes late.
opener: Ask Mathis to pay his share of the electricity bill that arrived today.

Camille.who: 29, woman, the flatmate who keeps the bill spreadsheet
Camille.knows: You know Mathis as your flatmate of two years, who is easygoing about most things. You know he is slow to send his share of the bills and tends to forget transfers.
Camille.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something about the bills needs sorting.
Camille.style: You use few emoji and rarely abbreviate, though you might write "ok" or "thx" occasionally.

Mathis.who: 31, man, the flatmate who pays the energy and internet bills
Mathis.knows: You know Camille as your flatmate of two years, who keeps the shared spreadsheet and sends reminders. You know she is careful with money and likes things settled on time.
Mathis.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly to reply when Camille asks you something.
Mathis.style: You use almost no emoji and write in plain, short messages without abbreviations.

private_lines.Camille: You work as a pharmacy assistant in Toulouse, mostly on weekdays and some Saturdays. You share the flat with Mathis, cook most evenings, and usually get home around seven on working days.
private_lines.Mathis: You work as a mechanic at a bike repair shop in Toulouse, with early starts on some days. You share the flat with Camille and usually get home in the late afternoon.
